new.text: 8.2.6 Dcm_EcuStartModeType [SWS_Dcm_00987] Definition of datatype Dcm_EcuStartModeType ⌈ Name Dcm_EcuStartModeType Kind Type Derived from uint8 DCM_COLD_START 0x00 The ECU starts normally Range DCM_WARM_START 0x01 The ECU starts from a bootloader jump Description Allows the DCM to know if a diagnostic response shall be sent in the case of a jump from bootloader Available via Dcm.h ⌋

new.text: 8.5.4 Dcm_GetProgConditions [SWS_Dcm_00544] Definition of configurable interface Dcm_GetProgConditions ⌈ Service Name Dcm_GetProgConditions Syntax Dcm_EcuStartModeType Dcm_GetProgConditions ( Dcm_ProgConditionsType * ProgConditions ) Service ID [hex] 0x62 Sync/Async Synchronous Reentrancy Non Reentrant Parameters (in) None Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) ProgConditions Conditions on which the jump from the bootloader has been requested Return value Dcm_EcuStartModeType – Description The Dcm_GetProgConditions callout is called upon Dcm initialization and allows to determine if a response ($50 or $51) has to be sent. The context parameters are defined in Dcm_Prog ConditionsType. Available via Dcm_Externals.h ⌋ Manager
